constraints: Update one major at a time. Each target major must be supported when you run ng update.
Keep @angular/core, @angular/cli, and every other @angular/* package on the same major.

steps.instructions: When a newer major than v22 is published, run `ng update @angular/core@<major> @angular/cli@<major>` for it and apply its steps in the Angular Update Guide.
steps.title: Plan the update to the next Angular major

steps.instructions: Check each reported @angular/core import against the Angular Update Guide for removed, renamed, or changed APIs.
steps.title: Review changed Angular APIs

verification.purpose: Confirm that @angular/core resolves to the target major.
Build the application on the target major.
Run the unit tests when the project defines them.

rule.summary: Angular's release schedule lists v22 with "LTS ends 2028-06", a month-precision date. Evergreen uses the last day of that month, 2028-06-30, as the deadline. LTS receives only critical fixes and security patches until the end of that month.
rule.title: @angular/core v22 reaches end of life on 2028-06-30
